import_identity_rules: Use source_id plus occurrence_id as stable source identity; keep original and corrected edition versions as provenance, not extra canonical hadiths.
Every primary reference is a retrieval/matching lead. Confirm the existing report, narrator, span and variant evidence before joining a reader group; number equality alone is insufficient.
A selected wording reference is the preferred comparison anchor, not a certification of word-for-word translation.
Cross-collection same-report-family variants retain their distinct collection occurrences and chain evidence even when a proven identity shares a reader group.
Broader supporting parallels and partial correspondences do not by themselves establish canonical identity or full Arabic/English counterpart equivalence.
Keep all 57 source occurrences. Group proven narration identities for the reader without deleting source occurrences, editions, alternate translations or before/after history.
External URLs are evidence metadata. Runtime source links must resolve to checksum-verifiable local files; do not require a live Sunnah.com lookup.
This local map introduces no new Arabic, English, grading, translation, licence or certification claim.
